head: Galaxy S27 camera specs leak: same main camera on S27 and S27+
dek: Leaked plans show the Galaxy S27 and S27+ keeping last year's main camera and the ultrawide used since the S23, while the S27 Pro and Ultra get a 200MP main camera, SammyGuru reports.
details: The Pro and Ultra would have a 50MP ultrawide and a 12MP telephoto, with 3x zoom on the Pro and 5x on the Ultra; the Ultra's second telephoto would be gone. Samsung is said to be still evaluating the setups and hasn't announced the phones.
where: Galaxy S27 series, expected early 2027, not announced
means: If camera upgrades matter to you, the base S27 may change little from the S26.
todo: Nothing to do yet; wait for Samsung's announcement before deciding on an upgrade.
